analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free in HTTP extra-packet reprocessing: ndpi_http_check_content() memcmp()s packet->content_disposition_line.ptr (derived from flow packet payload) during extra packet analysis, but that pointer can still reference a previously processed packet buffer that has already been freed by the fuzz harness. The crash occurs at http.c:149 in ndpi_http_check_content while reading stale content_disposition_line data.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz_ndpi_reader, each packet is copied to a temporary malloc buffer (packet_checked), passed to ndpi_workflow_process_packet(), then immediately freed. For flows where HTTP sets flow->extra_packets_func (ndpi_search_http_tcp_again), ndpi_process_extra_packet() may invoke HTTP parsing again on later packets. With crafted traffic that leaves HTTP header field pointers (notably content_disposition_line.ptr) in flow state and then triggers extra-packet parsing after the original backing buffer is freed, ndpi_http_check_content() performs memcmp on dangling memory, causing UAF.
